name: DIP switch (8)
description: Eight tiny on/off switches in one package. Switch 1 connects pin 1a to pin 1b when it is ON (pushed up toward the ON label), switch 2 connects 2a to 2b, and so on. Wire one side to GND and the other side to Arduino pins with INPUT_PULLUP: an ON switch reads LOW. Click a switch to flip it, even while the simulation runs.
